# mooncake tool list

List tools declared in the nearest mooncake.lock

## Description

Print one row per lock entry: name, version, backend, installed status,
and absolute bin path. Reads the nearest mooncake.lock (walks up from CWD).

## Flags

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `--format / -f` | string | `text` | Output format: text or json |
